description: This file defines Express.js route handlers related to user session management, including listing tenants, setting active tenant, alias routes, and toggling super admin mode. It interacts with auth middleware, audit logs, and tenant identification utilities.

methods.name: requireAuth
methods.description: Middleware to verify that the user is authenticated.

methods.name: asyncHandler
methods.description: Wraps asynchronous route handlers to catch errors.

methods.name: attachAuthContext
methods.description: Middleware to attach authentication context to requests.

methods.name: userHasTenant
methods.description: Checks if a user belongs to a specified tenant.

methods.name: normalizeUserTenants
methods.description: Normalizes the list of user tenants.

methods.name: isSuperAdminUser
methods.description: Determines if a user has super admin privileges based on their roles.

methods.name: isSuperAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the current request context belongs to a super admin.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Sanitizes or standardizes tenant ID values.
